description: SolarPV-DER-simulation-utility is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Photovoltaic", published or maintained by sibyjackgrove (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Allows user to run dynamics simulations for solar photovoltaic distributed energy resource connected to a stiff voltage source or to an external program. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Photovoltaic" (solar power). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support solar power studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
